seasonseries.title: West Ham United vs. Charlton Athletic

keyEvents.text: Goal! West Ham United 0, Charlton Athletic 1. Lloyd Jones (Charlton Athletic) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sonny Carey.
Substitution, West Ham United. Lewis Orford replaces Mohamadou Kanté.
Maximilian Kilman (West Ham United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Dan McNamara (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
